Subject: Cohort subsidy and sandbox cap — LaunchBridge partnership

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're drafting the logistics for the next LaunchBridge cohort (kicking off mid-Dec) and wanted to confirm a few items on the Redwood side before we finalize the partner benefits sheet:

- Typical stipend: do you offer a flat credit stipend per company, or a pool that LaunchBridge manages?
- Sandbox caps: can we set a daily token cap per company for safety during onboarding? If so, what are typical default caps?
- Top-ups: is there a mechanism for an ad-hoc top-up (for demo days / high-usage workshops) and who signs off?

Attached is a short PDF with our cohort structure and expected usage profile. We're trying to line up the MAP and want to know any limitations that would affect eligibility.

If we can confirm numbers this week, I can circulate a one-page mutual action plan to our ops folks.

Best,
Sarah Gomez

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Cohort subsidy and sandbox cap — LaunchBridge partnership

Hi Sarah — really appreciate the overview and the timing, excited to partner. Quick answers inline: 

- Stipend model: we can do either a per-company stipend (common for very early cohorts) or a program pool that LaunchBridge manages; for co-branded cohorts we typically recommend a hybrid: a base stipend per company + a small pool for demo-day top-ups.
- Sandbox caps: default onboarding cap is 100k tokens/day per company; we can raise to 200k/day for demo-day/week by request (temporary windows only).
- Top-ups: ad-hoc top-ups require approval from Sales Ops (up to $2k equivalent in credits) or a one-time Partner Exception approval for larger amounts.

I'll loop in Ben from Partnerships to propose an internal approval path and estimate the credit quantum for the cohort size you listed. I've attached a quick MAP draft for your team to review and mark up.

If it's helpful, can we schedule a 30-min call Thurs to run through use cases and sign-off flow?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachment: MAP_draft_v1.docx (docx, 120KB)

Marcus — saw the MAP and the cohort profile. A few internal notes / suggested guardrails before we commit: 

- Cohort size estimate: ~45 companies. If we do base $1k credit per company that's $45k; if we add a 10-company demo-day top-up at $2k that's +$20k. Recommend we structure as: $1k per company (automated credit issuance) + a $10k partner pool that LaunchBridge can request against (require 48h notice).
- Exception path: Approve one-time Partner Exception up to $10k (no additional legal review) tied to co-marketing (we need a short SOW or MSA addendum). Anything above $10k requires finance sign-off and RevOps alignment.
- Sandbox cap: set default 100k tokens/day but allow temporary 200k/day window for demo-week if LaunchBridge sends a request with dates.

If Marcus agrees, I'll task RevOps to create the issuance schedule and the coupon codes/API keys for the cohort. Also propose deal_id RB-2026-LB-1407.
